verdict.rationale: Scribe's own transcription API accepts a natural-language instruction (up to 2000 characters) that the product applies to the final transcript, returning an 'edited_transcript'. That is a narrow built-in way to hand an editing task to the product's AI, but it is not a general-purpose in-product assistant. The official MCP server is a separate integration story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: an interactive, conversational in-product assistant; delegation of tasks beyond post-transcription text editing; documentation of the assistant's UX and scope; independent or hands-on corroboration.
